question: What prompt-bearing Markdown validation contract should OpenClaw enforce across bootstrap files, SKILL.md loading, skill installs, and ClawHub publish/tag flows?
rationale: The remaining work changes security policy for model-visible content and install/publish trust decisions, so automation should not choose the permanent rule set, severity, override, or blocking model.

options.title: Define Shared Contract First
options.body: Approve one rule, severity, override, and tagging contract before implementing it across core prompt ingestion, skill loading, install/update, and ClawHub publish-side checks.

options.title: Land Scanner Subset First
options.body: Use the open scanner PR as a narrow first step while explicitly tracking bootstrap, runtime, install/update, and ClawHub publish-policy follow-up work.

options.title: Limit To ClawHub Policy
options.body: Keep local prompt-bearing Markdown outside core validation and enforce only publish/install trust warnings or tags through ClawHub policy.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Contract First
recommendation.body: Approve one rule, severity, override, and tagging contract before implementing it across core prompt ingestion, skill loading, install/update, and ClawHub publish-side checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He already scoped this issue in discussion and has the strongest adjacent history across the implicated prompt, workspace, and scanner surfaces.
